senses.gloss: (v. סוּמַּק) to be red (interch. with Pa. in Targ. editions).
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 31:18">Targ. Y. Num. XXXI, 18</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 49:12">Targ. Gen. XLIX, 12</cite> (Ms. <he>יְסוּמְקוּן</he>); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 84a:5">B. Bath. 84ᵃ</cite> <he>דקא סָמְקָא וכ׳</he> for it (the sun) is red in the morning and in the evening; a. e.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 49:11">Targ. Y. Gen. XLIX, 11</cite>.—

Lev. R. s. 12 (expl. כי יתאדם, Prov. XXIII, 31) ודאי מְסַמֵּיק ליה (or מַסְמִיק Hif.) the wine will surely make him red (excite him). Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵈ bot.; Y. Snh. VI, 23ᶜ בגין דלא מְסַמְּקָא אפוי (not מסמקי) in order not to make his face red (put him to shame); a. e.—Part. pass. מְסַמַּק; pl. מְסַמְּקִין, מְסַמְּקֵי.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Nahum 2:4">Targ. Nah. II, 4</cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Chullin 93b">Ḥull. 93ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 74b:9">Pes. 74ᵇ</cite> <he>אומצא דא׳</he> a piece of meat which is dark red (from congested blood).
<cite ref="Pesachim 74b:6">Ib.</cite> <he>בין א׳ בין לא א׳</he> whether the fluid looks red; a. e.
